videos.title: Oda Nobunaga: Japan's Revolutionary Warlord | History Unveiled
videos.description:
Imagine a land torn by endless war. Dive into the life of Oda Nobunaga, the revolutionary warlord who reshaped 16th-century Japan. Discover his military genius, political reforms, and ruthless ambition that laid the groundwork for a unified nation.

videos.title: The Peasants' Revolt: England's Forgotten Uprising
videos.description:
Uncover the dramatic story of the 1381 Peasants' Revolt, a pivotal moment in English history when common people challenged the monarchy. Learn about its causes, key figures like Wat Tyler, and its lasting impact on medieval society. This forgotten uprising highlights the power of social rebellion.

videos.title: Greek Fire: The Ancient Superweapon That Saved an Empire
videos.description:
Discover the mysterious Greek Fire, Byzantium's most devastating weapon. This ancient superweapon played a crucial role in defending Constantinople and shaped the course of history, its formula lost to time. Learn about its impact on naval warfare and the survival of the Byzantine Empire.
